name: custom/guide-single
title: Guide
description: Displays the Guide's full chapter accordion. Pulls its content live — nothing is duplicated into the block itself. Use this to show the Guide at a URL of your choosing (e.g. /learning/guide/) — the Guide post itself also has its own permalink independently (see guide-cpt.php), this is just a second way to reach the same content. No picker/attributes — the site has exactly one Guide, so this always shows that one automatically.
